answer.reason: Two events of the story happened in the wilderness of Paran: the cloud rested there, and Moses sent out the men to search Canaan from there.

clauses.english: was where the cloud rested when Israel left Sinai
clauses.quote: the cloud rested in the wilderness of Paran

clauses.english: was where Moses sent out men to search the land of Canaan
clauses.quote: Moses by the commandment of the LORD sent them from the wilderness of Paran

doubts: DEU 33:2 and HAB 3:3 speak of God shining forth from mount Paran in poetry, which is not an event, so they were left out.
DEU 1:1 only names Paran as a landmark, and 1KI 11:18 only mentions it as a stage of Hadad's flight, so both were left out.
GEN 21:21 (Ishmael dwelt there) and 1SA 25:1 (David went down there) were not used, to keep the line short.
